cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — perched on a ledge or edge; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — perched on a ledge or edge; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small independent riverside cinema lobby with old film reels and an unlettered ticket stand — she dresses as a retro cinema usher for a themed evening; a modern canal-side bakery terrace at blue hour — she pauses to break a warm pull-apart bun into two portions; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — chest-deep in the water; a cedar-wood tub by the window of a mountain inn — standing; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — holds a small screwdriver at chest height; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; overgrown jungle temple ruins — standing; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — standing
